title: SDG 10-C-1: Remittance Costs as a % of the Amount Remitted
description: Annual data on remittance costs as a proportion of the amount remitted, as per the specifications of SDG Indicator 10-C-1.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency.

fields.name: value
fields.title: Remittance Costs (%)
fields.description: [Float] The cost of remittance as a percentage of the amount remitted.

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from administrative records of cross-border transactions collected by the Central Bank of Malaysia, and subsequently reported to DOSM in aggregated form. It is collected as part of Malaysia's monitoring of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in line with the most recent [SDG Global Indicator Framework](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sdg.pdf).
caveat: The data is subject to revision in future updates.
